sieve.doc: Return the primes up to `limit` by the plain sieve of Eratosthenes. No dependencies.

BoundaryAlarm.scan.doc: Feed a whole sequence and record every crossing, in order.
BoundaryAlarm.scan.returns: the (index, value) pairs at which the boundary function fired

BoundaryAlarm.count_at.doc: Count the crossings that have fired by a position.

params.upto: position up to which crossings are counted

sigma_half_alarm.doc:
Fire when a σ trajectory crosses ½.

Demonstrates that BoundaryAlarm is not prime-specific: this is the Holcus
FIRING signal, wiki/44's halting reframe ("does it stop HERE, at this
depth"), on the same alarm primitive.

params.eps: tolerance within which a value counts as ½

sigma_half_alarm.returns: the (index, σ) pairs at which the alarm fired

PrimeGateEngine.gate_alarm.doc:
Return π(x): how many primes have fired the alarm by x. Gap-blind.

Uses a bisection fast path for the equivalent, slower definition
BoundaryAlarm(is_prime).count_at(range(2, x+1), x-1).

PrimeGateEngine.is_prime.doc: Return the boundary condition the alarm fires on.

PrimeGateEngine.curvature_spiral.doc:
Return the spiral whose heading accumulates the curvature κₙ = ln(pₙ).

This is a side investigation, not an alarm function. The heading uses
κₙ = ln(pₙ), not the raw gap gₙ, because summing gₙ telescopes back to pₙ.

params.scale: heading increment per unit of κ, in radians

PrimeGateEngine.curvature_spiral.returns: the (x, y) points of the spiral, starting at the origin
